question: In a certain code language, UNIVERSITY is written as EVINUYTISR. How will TEMPRATURE be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/512ece4c291b09e2acfa91f240a5c38fd0ef46139c790787ffc3579efe3f1d74.png] 

UNIVERSITY is written as EVINUYTISR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cba83b90b3ac142a9694c22a403581f75cc2d9d5722d58edb77fc82a3951a737.png] 

Similarly, 

TEMPRATURE be written as ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c29516c7539fa7450c8f2adcbf3e723b3399a1f48b230ec49a9498cbad1d2cb4.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **RPMETERUTA.**
